Independent unit: complete culture. Fold expansion is day5/day1 within the same culture, not a ratio of pooled means. Complete paired observations required. Missing cultures are excluded and listed by comparison through culture_values.csv. Original condition numbering. Three-RPM comparisons restricted to 100 mL, 80000 cells/mL. 60 RPM handling differs. Tests are observational comparisons, not isolated causal effects. Omnibus p-values are not pairwise p-values.
